ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Care CARE AND SAFETY and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Safety CARE AND SAFETY and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain : OUR SCHOOL and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
